title: 2.2 Invertebrates and Vertebrates
description: Exhaustive quiz examining the structural differences between invertebrate and vertebrate animal groups.

questions.question: What is the primary skeletal distinction of invertebrate animals?
options: They lack a backbone or vertebral column
They possess a well-defined axial skeleton made of cartilage
They feature an internal calcified vertebral column
They contain a dorsal notochord protected by bone
questions.correctAnswer: They lack a backbone or vertebral column

questions.question: What type of external skeletal structure do many soft-bodied invertebrates possess for protection?
options: An exoskeleton usually made of chitin
An endoskeleton made of living bone tissue
questions.correctAnswer: An exoskeleton usually made of chitin

questions.question: Which anatomical structure protects the highly developed brain in vertebrate animals?
What type of circulatory system is characteristic of vertebrate animals?
options: A closed circulatory system with a ventral heart
An open circulatory system lacking blood vessels
A decentralized vascular network without a heart
questions.correctAnswer: A closed circulatory system with a ventral heart
